doc_friction.issue: The look-before-you-choose step screenshots at phone and desktop widths only; the tablet band (721-959px), where 1,103 of 1,406 tool pages had a wrapped header at 768px, is never looked at. Suggest adding 768 to the widths.

The suggested background build command `node build.mjs > build.log 2>&1; echo DONE >> build.log` in run_in_background: wrapping it in a subshell with a trailing & made the harness report it complete at once while the build kept running; wait_for.py still worked.

deviations.why: Today's polish runs had a queue of per-page fold tweaks; measuring the shared header across widths turned up a site-wide defect (header wraps at tablet width) that affects every page, which the prompt ranks above single-page fixes.
deviations.did: Fixed the shared header CSS instead of the next fold item; listed the fold items in the new report's next steps.
deviations.result: one CSS change fixes 1,103+ tool pages at 768px and every page at 721-752px; tests 1929/1929.

notes: Measured with Playwright over all 1,406 venture pages at 744/768/820px on the full build. Before: nav wraps on 1,406/1,103/0. After (--only preview, Chromium 157): bar 82px site / 88px tool at 721-768px vs 117/123 before; 390px and 1024px+ unchanged. node --test 'platform/pages/*.test.mjs': 1929 pass, 0 fail. site-nav.test.mjs 25/25 including the new test. check.mjs on main's full build: publishable, no dead links. check_posts.py ok. Safari/Firefox not tested.

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
